title: Landing Page
description: The landing page provides links to the API definition, the Conformance declaration and to the resources exposed by the API.

title.title: The title of the API.
title.description: While a title is not required, implementers are strongly advised to include one.

description.example: Access to data about buildings in the city of Bonn via a Web API that conforms to the OGC API Common specification.

attribution.title: attribution for the API
attribution.description: The `attribution` should be short and intended for presentation to a user, for example, in a corner of a map. Parts of the text can be links to other resources if additional information is needed. The string can include HTML markup.
